messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- Ownership of the job scheduler transferred from the Dune team to the Cinder team on 2025-09-23. [decision; valid 2025-09-23 to now; recorded by handover/2025-09-23-scheduler]
- The job scheduler is owned by the Dune team as of 2025-06-25, when ownership moved from the Ember team. [decision; valid 2025-06-25 to now; recorded by handover/2025-06-25-scheduler]
    earlier: The Ember team owns the job scheduler. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-06-25; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-20]
- On 2025-07-30, on-call for the Atlas team passed from Tomasz to Priya Raman when Tomasz moved to the Dune team. [valid 2025-07-30 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-07-30]
- The Cinder team owns the job scheduler as of 2025-09-23, when ownership transferred from the Dune team. [decision; valid 2025-09-23 to now; recorded by handover/2025-09-23-scheduler]
    earlier: The Dune team owns the job scheduler as of 2025-09-05. [valid 2025-09-05 to 2025-09-23; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-05]
- On 2026-03-20, Marcus moved from the Boreal team to the Atlas team. [valid 2026-03-20 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-03-20]
- Tomasz was on the Atlas team on-call rotation as of 2025-04-03, but left it on 2025-07-30 when he moved to the Dune team. [valid 2025-07-30 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-07-30]
    earlier: Tomasz is back on the Atlas team on-call rotation as of 2025-04-03. [valid 2025-04-03 to 2025-07-30; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-04-03]
    earlier: Tomasz had the first on-call rotation for the Atlas team but is off rotation as of 2025-02-12. [valid 2025-02-12 to 2025-04-03; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-02-12]
    earlier: Tomasz has the first on-call rotation for the Atlas team. [valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-02-12; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-09]
- As of 2025-09-23, the pager for the job scheduler rings the Cinder team, not the Dune team. [valid 2025-09-23 to now; recorded by handover/2025-09-23-scheduler]
- The Atlas team has moved to the second floor. [valid 2025-12-25 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-12-25]
- On 2026-05-22, the Dune team observed that the job scheduler's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump. [valid 2026-05-22 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-05-22-3]
- The Boreal team consists of Lena, after Marcus moved to the Atlas team on 2026-03-20. [valid 2026-03-20 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-03-20]
    earlier: The Boreal team consists of Lena and Marcus. [valid 2025-01-07 to 2026-03-20; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-07]
- Diego is on call for Cinder to start the year. [valid 2025-01-09 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-09]
- The webhook dispatcher is owned by the Boreal team as of 2025-05-15, when ownership moved from the Ember team. [valid 2025-05-15 to now; recorded by handover/2025-05-15-webhooks]
    earlier: The webhook dispatcher is owned by the Ember team, which took over ownership from the Boreal team on 2025-03-03. [valid 2025-03-03 to 2025-05-15; recorded by handover/2025-03-03-webhooks]
    earlier: The webhook dispatcher is owned by the Boreal team. [valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-03-03; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-09-3]
- As of 2025-08-19, deploys to the job scheduler happen only on Tuesdays and Fridays between 09:00 and 10:30 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-08-19 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-08-19]
    earlier: Deploys to the job scheduler happen only on Tuesdays between 13:00 and 15:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-02-06 to 2025-08-19; recorded by standup/ember/2025-02-06]
- As of 2026-03-20, the Atlas team consists of Priya Raman and Marcus, after Marcus moved from the Boreal team. [valid 2026-03-20 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-03-20]
    earlier: As of 2025-07-30, the Atlas team consists of Priya Raman, after Tomasz left the team to join the Dune team. [valid 2025-07-30 to 2026-03-20; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-07-30]
    earlier: The Atlas team in 2025 consists of Priya Raman and Tomasz. [valid 2025-01-06 to 2025-07-30; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-06]
- The Ember team handed the authentication gateway to Cinder on 2025-09-16; Cinder owns it as of that date. [decision; valid 2025-09-16 to now; recorded by handover/2025-09-16-auth-gateway]
    earlier: The Ember team owns the authentication gateway. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-09-16; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-20]
- From 2026-03-30 to 2026-04-03 there are no deploys to the ledger service because of the fiscal year close. [constraint; valid 2026-03-11 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-03-11]
- As of 2025-11-27, Yuki Tanaka takes the Cinder pager from Diego. [valid 2025-11-27 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-11-27]
